gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 13 build now carries the dedicated devres reviewability gate beside the existing helper tests so the iomap or mmio safety survey cannot drift silently.
The existing make target keeps the Phase 13 devres survey packet runnable through the same repeatable release path as the other shared helper anchors.

The landed helper lab already models the pure helper-first shape of __devm_ioremap() and __devm_ioremap_resource() while the shipped descriptor now says explicitly that the surface still avoids live device-resource ownership, live MMIO state, live DMA-backed mappings, and scatterlist ownership.
Dedicated tests already exercise managed ioremap, managed resource, ioport, device-tree iomap, WC token, and WC memtype bookkeeping so the helper slice is observable on master.
The slice note already keeps the current helper boundary explicit so the lane does not overstate itself as live devres teardown or live MMIO parity.

A dedicated reviewability gate ties the helper lab, dedicated tests, manifest lane marker, and survey note together so the active helper-first devres packet and its explicit live-state blockers stay machine-checkable on the live head.

The dedicated iounmap reviewability gate source-scans the helper descriptor and replays exact-match plus release-miss devm_iounmap() planning so the helper-advertised provides_iounmap_call_planning surface stays explicit inside the broader devres packet instead of living only in the helper lab or survey prose.
The survey note records the current helper-first devres packet on the live head, including the remaining live MMIO, DMA, scatterlist, device-tree, and arch memtype blockers explicitly.

The helper lab now keeps __devm_ioremap(), devm_ioremap(), devm_ioremap_uc(), devm_ioremap_wc(), devm_ioremap_np(), and devm_iounmap() in pure lifetime-planning form around retained release records, free-on-failure cleanup, and exact detach pointer matching.

The helper lab now keeps devm_ioremap_np() explicit as the direct non-posted managed wrapper instead of leaving that MMIO-safety path only implicit through the shared lifetime helper or the resource planner's non-posted fallback.

The helper lab now models __devm_ioremap_resource(), keeps the direct devm_ioremap_resource() plain wrapper explicit, and covers devm_ioremap_resource_uc() plus devm_ioremap_resource_wc() around memory-resource validation, overflow-safe inclusive size calculation, pretty-name construction, request-region gating, remap cleanup, and non-posted resolution.

The helper lab now keeps devm_of_iomap() bounded to of_address_to_resource() translated-resource selection, optional size reporting, and delegation into the managed-resource planner without pretending to walk a live device tree or map duplicate regions.

The helper lab now models devm_ioport_map() and devm_ioport_unmap() around release-record retention, free-on-failure cleanup, and exact pointer-match release bookkeeping without claiming live port-space side effects.
The helper lab now keeps devm_arch_phys_wc_add() helper-first by retaining the returned WC token for detach-time cleanup through arch_phys_wc_del() and freeing the release record on failure.

The helper lab now keeps devm_arch_io_reserve_memtype_wc() helper-first by retaining the reserved range for detach-time release through arch_io_free_memtype_wc() and freeing the release record on failure.

The helper packet now keeps dmam_alloc_coherent() and dmam_free_coherent() helper-first in a dedicated sibling planner that records release-record allocation, success-path retention of the returned CPU address plus DMA handle for detach-time cleanup, free-on-partial-failure cleanup when either half of the coherent mapping never materializes, and exact free-time tuple matching without claiming live DMA-backed execution or scatterlist ownership.

The current lane still does not claim live devres_alloc_node() ownership, devres_add() installation, devm_request_mem_region() side effects, or direct ioremap() / iounmap() execution against real MMIO state.

The current helper lab does not claim dmam_alloc_coherent(), dmam_free_coherent(), dma_map_resource(), dma_unmap_resource(), dma_map_sgtable(), or any other live DMA-backed mapping, unmapping, or ownership state.

The current helper lab does not claim live struct scatterlist, sg_table, sg_* traversal, or other scatter-gather ownership, iteration, merging, or detach-time cleanup beyond the existing helper-first MMIO and memtype planners.
The current helper lab does not claim live struct device_node traversal, reg-property address translation, or overlapping-device-tree coordination beyond the pure devm_of_iomap() planner boundary.
The current helper lab does not claim live arch_phys_wc_add(), arch_io_reserve_memtype_wc(), or global memtype-state mutation beyond the token-style and range-style detach bookkeeping planners.
